title: BLOCKED, needs you: no GitHub push access on the VPS (live-key-checks can't open its PR)
asked: Build live key + health checks in the banners (Angel live-key-checks). The work is done and committed on the VPS worktree, but nothing on the VPS can push: /opt/axf and the build worktrees have no git credentials, and the VPS gh token is invalid (same dead GitHub token Brett reported).

steps.text: WIZARD 1 (Brett): make a new fine-grained GitHub token for MossesX/AmberX-AXF (Contents, Pull requests, Actions, Workflows: read and write; Metadata: read): https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new?name=AXF+Dev+Console&target_name=MossesX&expires_in=90&contents=write&pull_requests=write&actions=write&workflows=write&metadata=read
WIZARD 2 (Brett): paste it in the console's Keys needed banner (GitHub token) so the console's GITHUB_TOKEN works again

WIZARD 3 (Mosses): on the VPS give git push access (gh auth login --with-token from that token, then gh auth setup-git), then in /root/axf-builds/claude-live-key-checks: git push -u origin claude/live-key-checks and gh pr create --base main --head claude/live-key-checks (don't merge)

resume.next: Mosses brief: Brett has set a new GitHub token. On the VPS run gh auth login --with-token (token from the console's credential store or Brett), gh auth setup-git, then cd /root/axf-builds/claude-live-key-checks && git push -u origin claude/live-key-checks && gh pr create --base main --head claude/live-key-checks --title 'Live key + health checks in the banners (Angel live-key-checks)' --body-file _claude/memory/docs/live-key-checks/README.md. Do not merge. Then close this entry.
